sloka: भद्रे हृदयमप्येतदन्नुमृश्योद्धरस्व मे ।एतत्समीक्ष्य कैकेयि ब्रूहि यत्साधु मन्यसे ॥२-११-९॥
transliteration: bhadre hṛdayamapyetadannumṛśyoddharasva me ।etatsamīkṣya kaikeyi brūhi yatsādhu manyase ॥2-11-9॥

translations.english: O gentle lady my heart is sinking. Touch my heart and deliver me from distress. O Kaikeyi considering all this, tell me what you think is good.
